note: IMM 0008 (05-2026) barcode rules. Each rule names its source in the official template (imm0008e.pdf, sha256 2560489b…3285). Rules are added only from the template or the Adobe evidence, never to make a mismatch pass.
manifests_note: encodeAll() pairs PaperFormsBarcode1-8 (subform BC1) and 9-10 (BC2) with manifests barcode1-barcode10 in that order. Slot 1 of every barcode is Header.titleSF.CRCNum, the form's checksum set by Validate. Manifests reach dependant rows dependants[1..3]; the tool binds them like row 0 with the row index set (bind_repeats).

derived.rule: full telephone number calculated into the hidden, read-only ActualNumber field (template: ActualNumber calculate script; Other: "+" + country code + number, spaces removed)

telephone format switch (Other: the international number box); the number itself is encoded through ActualNumber

month_boxes.DOBMM[0]: month of birth: the template binds DOBMM with picture num{99}, so Adobe holds 4 and the barcode encodes 4 while the saved data keeps 04 (same rule as P1's DOBMonth on IMM 1295)
